subject.title: fix: allow custom control UI origins

question: Should this auth-boundary PR remain blocked until redacted live Gateway or desktop-wrapper proof is supplied, or can maintainers accept the current source, CI, and Gateway harness proof?
rationale: The code path is narrow and well-covered, but the external-PR real behavior proof gate is not satisfied by tests, CI, or a proof-check workflow alone.

options.title: Require live allowlist proof
options.body: Ask for redacted deployed-Gateway or desktop-wrapper evidence showing exact custom-scheme allowlist success and unlisted custom-scheme rejection before merge.

options.title: Accept current proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly waive the live-proof gap based on the narrow source diff, parser tests, Gateway handshake test, and green checks.

options.title: Choose another candidate
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want to advance a sibling exact custom-scheme origin fix instead.

recommendation.title: Require live allowlist proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted deployed-Gateway or desktop-wrapper evidence showing exact custom-scheme allowlist success and unlisted custom-scheme rejection before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and repeatedly maintained the Control UI/Gateway origin-auth boundary that this proof decision affects.
